label: GO after a1 reached S2 unrewarded, damped if the trial before was rewarded, scaled by S1 belief
short_terms: (phase == GO) * last_is('a1 S2 u') ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is('a1 S2 u') * (tv('reward', -2) == 1)
terms: (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S2 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("reward", -2) == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a1 S2 u") * (tv("action", -2) == 1)
explanation: Active almost only at GO. Magnitude is driven by the previous trial being a1 -> S2 (rare) unrewarded, the model-based stay-on-a1 case (residual +1.0 vs ~-0.1 for every other pattern); this single indicator gives dev R^2 0.47 beyond timing. Within that case the activation is much smaller if the trial before was rewarded (weight -0.68) and grows with the observer log-odds that S1 is good (+0.28). D1 and D2 carry essentially nothing. The free fit adds small terms (a1 S1 u, a2 S2 u, trial-before action a1, a GO-wide belief term) for only ~0.03 more dev R^2; residual misses are scattered high-activation GO steps after other unrewarded trials (e.g. a1 S1 u) when the agent keeps choosing a1. All terms are observed-only.

issues: The 'scaled by S1 belief' part of the label is weakly supported and mostly a fitted correction. Adding (GO)*last_is('a1 S2 u')*belief_lo to the bare indicator gives weight +0.013 and test R^2 0.4438 vs 0.4439, so it adds nothing. It reaches weight +0.28 only alongside the reward(-2) term, where it adds 0.005 (0.479 -> 0.484), which is the pattern of a suppressor term. Using raw belief instead of belief_lo flips the base weight to -0.63, another sign of curve fitting.
The damping claim holds: the indicator alone scores 0.444 test, adding (tv('reward',-2)==1) scores 0.479, with weight -0.58 against a base of +1.36.

Misses show a systematic class the label leaves out. At GO after other unrewarded trials (a1 S1 u, a2 S2 u, a2 choices) there are many windows with activation around 1-2.4 where the prediction is about 0.1. The most under-predicted GO cell is 'after a1 S1 u' (+0.032). The short form is also over-predicted by about -0.09 on every GO cell after a rewarded trial. A GO-wide term for 'previous trial unrewarded' scaled by belief_lo captures part of this.

A better short form exists that passes --short. It replaces the belief term inside the a1 S2 u case with a belief term over all unrewarded trials: (phase == GO) * last_is('a1 S2 u') ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_reward == 0) * belief_lo ;; (phase == GO) * last_is('a1 S2 u') * (tv('reward', -2) == 1) scores test R^2 0.501, vs 0.484 recorded. A less readable variant reached 0.509.
